parties: Kangchenjunga Limited | Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited
headline: Kangchenjunga Limited files SEBI takeover disclosure for Spandana Sphoorty Financial
sum: Kangchenjunga Limited has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) in respect of Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited. No financial terms, consideration or transaction structure disclosed in available sources.
implication: SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure is mandatory upon crossing 25% shareholding threshold or triggering takeover code; review current shareholding patterns and open offer obligations.
detail: The disclosure was filed with NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The filing document itself (referenced as team_sandeshc_13052026124553_22.pdf) remains inaccessible via public search. No corroborating reports of consideration, shareholding percentage acquired, or transaction mechanics have been located in credible financial or legal press as of the reference date.
